newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mixed, West Coast strong - Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mixed, West Coast strong - Sept 24.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed on Tuesday as tight supply and good demand helped raise values on the West Coast, traders said.
"There is a slight shortness in supply and some good demand in Los Angeles today," said one West Coast trader, adding the market is likely to firm in the week.
Los Angeles 380 CST traded between $115 a tonne and $116 a tonne, $7 higher from prices late last week. 180 CST was assessed $121/122, $6 firmer.
"No one is willing to sell their barrels at lower levels," said one Los Angeles trader.
